# source: siunitx.sty v3 command declarations (\NewDocumentCommand: \num,
# \ang, \unit, \qty, \si, \SI, \numrange, \qtyrange, \SIrange, \numlist,
# \qtylist, \numproduct, \qtyproduct, \complexnum, \complexqty, \tablenum,
# \sisetup, \DeclareSIUnit) — the implementation of the manual's command
# reference — and its unit/prefix declarations, the manual's unit tables.
# Numbers spell with the locale's digit grouping and decimal marker; units
# from the transcribed symbol table, powers as real superscripts; a unit
# outside the table is W0381, set as its ASCII spelling. The list, product,
# complex, table and declaration forms refuse by name.
body impl \num{12345}
body impl \num{3.14159}
body impl \num{1e6}
body impl \num{-2.5e-3}
body impl \SI{1.5}{\kilo\gram}
body impl \qty{1.5}{\kilo\gram}
body impl \qty{9.81}{\metre\per\second\squared}
body impl \si{\metre\per\second}
body impl \unit{\ohm}
body impl \unit{\square\centi\metre}
body impl \ang{45}
body impl \ang{1;2;3}
body impl \numrange{5}{10}
body impl \qtyrange{1}{2}{\metre}
body impl \SIrange{1}{2}{\metre}
body refuse:W0381 \qty{1}{\banana}
body refuse:W0301 \numlist{1;2;3}
body refuse:W0301 \qtylist{1;2;3}{\metre}
body refuse:W0301 \numproduct{2 x 3}
body refuse:W0301 \qtyproduct{2 x 3}{\metre}
body refuse:W0301 \complexnum{1+2i}
body refuse:W0301 \complexqty{1+2i}{\ohm}
body refuse:W0301 \tablenum{1.5}
pre refuse:W0301 \sisetup{per-mode=symbol}
pre refuse:W0301 \DeclareSIUnit\px{px}
